title: Atlas reset
text: Atlas passwords can be reset by email. Temporary accounts require a support agent.

title: Atlas expiry
text: Atlas reset links expire after 30 minutes. Request a new link if the old link has expired.

title: Atlas export
text: Atlas exports reports as CSV files. Only workspace owners can export all reports.

title: Boreal reset
text: Boreal reset links expire after 10 minutes. Password reset uses a mobile app.

title: Atlas billing
text: Atlas invoices are sent monthly. Workspace owners can download invoices from Billing.
